samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
    <description>Implement a pulse detect module.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <enum id="s0">0. Initial state. A state waiting for pulse 0.</enum>
        <enum id="s1">1. A state waiting for pulse 1.</enum>
        <enum id="s2">2. A state waiting for pulse 0.</enum>
        <enum id="s3">3. A state waiting for pulse 1.</enum>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <sequencial id="pulse_level1" type="sequencial_logic">sequencial logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level1 = s0. Otherwise, pulse_level1 = pulse_level2.</sequencial>
        <sequencial id="pulse_level2" type="sequencial_logic">sequencial logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level2 = s0. Otherwise, combinational logic.</sequencial>
        <combinational id="data_out" type="combinational_logic">combinational logic. If ~rst_n, data_out = 0. Otherwise, data_out = (pulse_level2 == s2) & (data_in == 0).</combinational>
        <combinational id="pulse_level2_case1" type="combinational_logic">combinational logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level2 = s0. Otherwise, if pulse_level1 == s0, pulse_level2 = (data_in == 0) ? s1 : s0.</combinational>
        <combinational id="pulse_level2_case2" type="combinational_logic">combinational logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level2 = s0. Otherwise, if pulse_level1 == s1, pulse_level2 = (data_in == 1) ? s2 : s1.</combinational>
        <combinational id="pulse_level2_case3" type="combinational_logic">combinational logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level2 = s0. Otherwise, if pulse_level1 == s2, pulse_level2 = (data_in == 0) ? s3 : s0.</combinational>
        <combinational id="pulse_level2_case4" type="combinational_logic">combinational logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level2 = s0. Otherwise, if pulse_level1 == s3, pulse_level2 = (data_in == 1) ? s2 : s1.</combinational>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <sequencial id="pulse_level1" type="sequencial_logic">sequencial logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level1 = s0. Otherwise, pulse_level1 = pulse_level2.</sequencial>
        <sequencial id="pulse_level2" type="sequencial_logic">sequencial logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level2 = s0. Otherwise, combinational logic.</sequencial>
        <combinational id="data_out" type="combinational_logic">combinational logic. If ~rst_n, data_out = 0. Otherwise, data_out = (pulse_level2 == s2) & (data_in == 0).</combinational>
        <combinational id="pulse_level2_case1" type="combinational_logic">combinational logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level2 = s0. Otherwise, if pulse_level1 == s0, pulse_level2 = (data_in == 0) ? s1 : s0.</combinational>
        <combinational id="pulse_level2_case2" type="combinational_logic">combinational logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level2 = s0. Otherwise, if pulse_level1 == s1, pulse_level2 = (data_in == 1) ? s2 : s1.</combinational>
        <combinational id="pulse_level2_case3" type="combinational_logic">combinational logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level2 = s0. Otherwise, if pulse_level1 == s2, pulse_level2 = (data_in == 0) ? s3 : s0.</combinational>
        <combinational id="pulse_level2_case4" type="combinational_logic">combinational logic. If ~rst_n, pulse_level2 = s0. Otherwise, if pulse_level1 == s3, pulse_level2 = (data_in == 1) ? s2 : s1.</combinational>
    </implementation>
</module>
